picks.title: Microsoft and OpenAI end their exclusive and revenue-sharing deal
picks.why_it_matters: A major restructuring of the most important AI partnership signals OpenAI may seek new capital partners and opens competitive opportunities for startups building on alternative foundation models.

picks.title: India's Snabbit closes $56M round as investor interest in on-demand home services heats up
picks.why_it_matters: Validates renewed investor appetite for operationally-intensive marketplace models in emerging markets, with unit economics improving at scale—a template for similar plays in other geographies.

picks.title: Investors back Skye's AI home screen app for iPhone ahead of launch
picks.why_it_matters: Pre-launch funding for a consumer AI interface signals growing conviction that the OS/home screen layer is up for grabs as AI reshapes how users interact with their devices.
